text:
mia: Quick async standup — SDK quickstarts + sampleapp checks

mia: What I did: updated Python quickstart with token rotation note, pushed docs patch to draft PR (link: https://github.com/redwood/devex-docs/pull/842).
mia: Blockers: windows CI failing on sampleapp e2e (see sam's CI report), need a Windows-savvy reviewer for the sampleapp fix.
mia: Today: triage the e2e failure, land the small docs change, and finish the TypeScript snippet in quickstart.

sam: Saw the CI failure — looks like path separator issue in the test harness on Windows. Repro locally in WSL2.
sam: Quick workaround: change test to use os.path.join or use pathlib. I'll open a tiny PR against the sampleapp test harness in a bit.

jordan: Thanks, @sam. I can review that PR. Also I noticed the TS quickstart still references old client init options (api_key vs token). I'll send a follow-up PR to align examples.

lee: QA note: sampleapp e2e produced this error in the run: `FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'scripts\\setup_env.bat'` — looks like backslashes doubled in the fixture generator.

docs-bot: CI / sampleapp-e2e #412 failed on windows-latest (https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/412). Logs uploaded.

sam: Lee — can you paste the minimal failing stack? I want to confirm it's the fixture generator and not something else.

lee: pasted minimal stack to the PR comments. Short snippet: ```Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests\test_e2e.py", line 34, in test_full_flow
    subprocess.check_call([setup_script])
FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'scripts\\setup_env.bat'
```

mia: Ok — plan: @sam to open hotfix PR for path handling, @jordan to update TS quickstart examples, I'll finish docs PR and ping @sam for the sampleapp reviewer after PR is up.

mia: If anyone can volunteer to smoke the Windows runner after the fix, that'd be great — otherwise I'll schedule a quick run later today. :wave:

sam: I'll open the PR now, pinging @jordan for review.

jordan: On it, will review in ~30m.

lee: After PR lands I'll re-run the failing job and report back.

mia: Thanks all — short and sweet. Drop any follow-ups here or DM me if blocked. :thumbsup:
